label: digit 2 at positions 4-6 of an a-initial sequence (after i/c/x/l)
explanation: Sparse conjunctive feature (about 0.01% of steps). Nearly all activation mass (96%) is on original-phase steps of sequences whose FIRST token is a (27x lift), at positions 4-6 (t=3 and 7 are rare; never at t<3 or t>7). It is strongest when the input is the digit 2 (61% of mass, 17x lift), especially when the earlier prefix contains i, c or x (e.g. a a l i c [2], max act 4.5; prev2_tok i 10x, prev_tok c 8x). Weaker activations occur on other tokens at positions 4-6 in a-initial sequences containing i/c/x, and a small amount (4%) on the <DEL> step when output is a. It never fires in the copy phase after recall_idx 0. Many a-initial sequences with 2 at positions 4-6 do not fire, so precision is limited; the exact prefix condition is not fully captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=a (+7.10), orig1=a (+3.96), prev_tok=c (+2.86), orig2=i (+2.84), t=5 (+2.36), orig1=i (+1.97). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.94), prev3_tok=- (-2.49), phase=2 (-2.13), t=3 (-1.51).
